announcedNextVersion.objectiveMapping: Not claimed; re-map against that version before using for its preparation.

coverageMeaning: Partial conceptual/task alignment only. Objective numbers are pointers, not completion claims. Configuration and verification verbs are not satisfied by synthetic exercises.

lessons.taught: Trace a frame against VLAN membership, source learning, allowed VLANs and a routing boundary.
lessons.remainingGap: Voice VLAN behavior, actual multi-switch configuration and IOS verification remain untested.
lessons.localEvidence: VLAN-scoped source learning, fixed unicast decisions and trunk allowed-list intersections only.

lessons.taught: Explain loop prevention, root identifiers and costs; discuss rapid/edge/protection concepts without calculating operational port roles.
lessons.remainingGap: No forwarding-role/state computation, convergence timing, BPDUs, complete tie-break implementation or real guard behavior/recovery.
lessons.localEvidence: Lowest supplied priority/MAC identifier, cumulative root costs and explicit equal-cost ambiguity; no operational port roles.

lessons.taught: Reject incompatible members and passive/passive pairing; explain flow hashing.
lessons.remainingGap: No L2/L3 EtherChannel configuration, actual hardware hash, member failure timing or throughput measurement.
lessons.localEvidence: Supplied active/passive pair and reference-member compatibility checks only; no negotiation or hash.

lessons.taught: Interpret addresses, prefixes, link-local scope and neighbor discovery evidence.
lessons.remainingGap: Address configuration, client OS checks, SLAAC/DAD execution, anycast and modified EUI-64 need separate practice.
lessons.localEvidence: Fixed address category, prefix membership and refusal to infer reachability from an invented observation.

lessons.taught: Separate candidate selection from installed-route lookup; reason about backup eligibility.
lessons.remainingGap: No actual IPv4/IPv6 static-route installation, recursive resolution, tracked failover or forwarding-plane verification.
lessons.localEvidence: Same-prefix candidate selection by supplied AD, then longest-prefix lookup; supplied active flags only.

lessons.taught: Discuss neighbor prerequisites, router-ID uniqueness and shared-segment roles; separately calculate supplied graph costs.
lessons.remainingGap: No router-ID validation, neighbor state machine, adjacency formation, LSA exchange, actual OSPF SPF process, DR/BDR election or IOS configuration.
lessons.localEvidence: Boolean prerequisite checks and shortest costs over a supplied graph; no router-ID comparison, roles or adjacency state.

lessons.taught: Separate ordered filtering, address translation, relay, names and time.
lessons.remainingGap: No NAT pool allocation, packet-dependent translation order, real DHCP/DNS/NTP exchanges, ACL attachment or synchronized clock verification.
lessons.localEvidence: First-match explicit-network ACL and independent static source mapping; DNS, DHCP and NTP discussed only.

lessons.taught: Distinguish RF contention, association/authentication and downstream addressing.
lessons.remainingGap: No RF survey, AP/WLC GUI, WLAN creation, WPA2-PSK verification, roaming or regional compliance test.
lessons.localEvidence: Capability/security-label eligibility and simple 2.4 GHz/20 MHz channel comparison; no architecture or RF test.

lessons.taught: Validate typed JSON-shaped records, review a desired-state diff and discuss HTTP method semantics; no response-code exercise.
lessons.remainingGap: No controller access, credentials, HTTP requests, device writes, Ansible/Terraform execution or AI/ML competency assessment.
lessons.localEvidence: Typed fixed-record diff and dependency order; HTTP methods discussed only.

lessons.taught: Build a causal diagnosis and smallest discriminating next check from synthetic cross-layer evidence.
lessons.remainingGap: Integrated reasoning only; no new full-objective coverage or production/emulator readiness.
lessons.localEvidence: Aggregation of supplied supporting findings, one contradiction and two gaps; no new observations.
